SAN CLEMENTE FIRE: EVACUATE NOW IF YOU’RE IN THESE ZONES

Evacuation orders have been issued for the Norte Fire, which is burning near Portico Del Norte:

📍 San Juan Capistrano Zones 4, 5, 10
📍 San Clemente Zone 12

The fire started around 11:30 a.m. and has grown to at least 250 acres. Santa Ana winds are pushing it, and temperatures are in the 90s. Homes are in the area, and OCFA says structures are threatened. Helicopters and ground crews are attacking the fire.
